verdict.rationale: Basecamp is a project-management and team-communication product (to-dos, message boards, chat, card tables), not a code-hosting or coding-agent tool. Line-level review of AI-generated code diffs with agent iteration falls outside its category. Nothing in the evidence shows it hosts code or diffs or supports line comments; its AI-agent support (MCP, CLI, skills) covers agents working with Basecamp data, not code review.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can review AI agent code changes and comment on specific lines from a mobile app, then have the agent iterate
